blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines had 2.8 million registered persons with disabilities (PWDs) as of Aug. 3, according to the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA). Although the number of registered PWDs is documented, the extent of discrimination they experience and their awareness of available resources remain concerns that deserve public attention.
